items.title: Switch project, open any element and navigate from the command palette (⌘K)
items.story: As Alex, I want to switch project, open any element and navigate from the command palette (⌘K), so that everything is one shortcut away

acceptance_criteria.title: Open an element by its id
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture and the custom fixture added
And the kanban fixture is open
And I am Alex
When I press Ctrl+K, type "task-003" and press Enter
Then the element panel of "task-003-logout" opens

acceptance_criteria.title: Switch project from the palette
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture and the custom fixture added
And the kanban fixture is open
And I am Alex
When I press Ctrl+K, type "custom", select "Switch to custom" with the arrow keys and press Enter
Then the custom fixture is open on the same screen

acceptance_criteria.title: Navigate to a screen
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture and the custom fixture added
And the kanban fixture is open
And I am Alex
When I press Ctrl+K, type "timeline" and press Enter
Then Timeline opens

acceptance_criteria.title: Say when nothing matches
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture and the custom fixture added
And the kanban fixture is open
And I am Alex
When I press Ctrl+K and type "zzz-no-such-thing"
Then the palette shows "No match"

acceptance_criteria.title: Close the palette with Escape
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture and the custom fixture added
And the kanban fixture is open
And I am Alex
Given the palette is open
When I press Escape
Then the palette closes and the focus returns to where it was

items.title: The next workflow step for my role in Requires you

acceptance_criteria.title: List rejected work before the next step

items.title: The progress card to show phase X of Y of the current workflow
items.story: As Casey, I want the progress card to show phase X of Y of the current workflow, so that I know where the project is in its life cycle

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the current phase of the scope

And I am Casey
Given the custom fixture with the sw-life-cycle preset is open on WingFoil 0.3

items.title: A time axis of Memory creations and state changes per day, parsed from wf(…) commits

And I am Casey

And the column 2026-09-28 shows 1 creation above the axis and 1 state change below
And the column 2026-09-30 shows 1 state change below the axis

acceptance_criteria.title: List the events of a day

And I am Casey
Given Timeline is open on the Time axis
When I select the column 2026-09-28

acceptance_criteria.title: Filter Memory changes only

And I am Casey
Given the fixture has a branch "feature/x" with 1 commit not on "main"

items.title: WingFoil 0.3 workflow and agent verbs
items.description: With WingFoil 0.3 the server reads the workflow position and the next step (`workflow status`, `workflow next`), starts ingestions through `workflow start` where it sets the required fields, and launches agents with `agent execute`, streaming their output. Exact options and output are confirmed against WingFoil 0.3 at v0.4 `release-planning` and captured as contracts (REQ-INT-01).
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] Every listed scenario passes on a fixture pinning WingFoil 0.3, and each verb used has a contract (REQ-INT-01).

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the next step for my role
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports the next step "dev-loop · red" for role "developer" on "task-003-element-panel"
When I open Today
Then the Next workflow step card shows "dev-loop · red — task-003-element-panel"

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the current phase of the scope
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Casey
Given the custom fixture with the sw-life-cycle preset is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports `release-cycle` of "minor-v0.1" at phase "implementation"
When I open Today
Then the progress card shows "Phase 2 of 7 — implementation"

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the context the agent will receive
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with the next step "dev-loop · red" on "task-003-element-panel"
When I expand the Next workflow step card
Then it shows the role "developer", the directives bound to "developer", the DNA module of the task, the specs it references and the branch "task/task-003-element-panel"

acceptance_criteria.title: Mark the current position and who must act
steps: Given the console is running
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3
And the workflow engine reports `sw-life-cycle` at "release-line-cycle" › "rl-v1" › "delivery" › "minor-v0.1" › "implementation" with role "developer"
When I open Workflow
Then "init", "inception" and "specification" are marked done
And "implementation" under "minor-v0.1" is marked current with "developer must act"

acceptance_criteria.title: Launch the agent on the next step after confirming
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on WingFoil 0.3 with the next step "dev-loop · red" on "task-003-element-panel"
And the UI setting "Confirm agent launch" is on
When I click "Launch agent" and confirm the modal showing the step's context and the branch "task/task-003-element-panel"
Then the server starts `wingfoil agent execute` for "task-003-element-panel" with role "developer"
And the button reads "View agent's logs"

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the end of a successful run
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the log view of a run is open
When the agent exits with status 0
Then the log view shows "Finished · exit 0"
And the button on the step reads "Launch agent"

acceptance_criteria.title: Show a failed run with its exit status
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the log view of a run is open
When the agent exits with status 2
Then the log view shows "Failed · exit 2" and keeps the output
And the button on the step reads "Launch agent"

acceptance_criteria.title: Report an agent that cannot start
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given `wingfoil agent execute` exits with an error before printing any output
When I launch the agent on the next step
Then a red toast shows the error message printed by `wingfoil agent execute`
And the button reads "Launch agent"

acceptance_criteria.title: Report a bug with its severity set by the CLI
steps: Given the console is running
And I am Jordan
Given the custom fixture is open on a WingFoil that sets the required fields of a bug
And I start "bug-ingest"
When I type the title "Toast hides the Push button", choose the severity "medium" and click "Submit"
Then the fixture's commits for "bug-002-toast-hides-the-push-button" are made by the CLI only
And the bug's frontmatter has `severity: medium` and the state "open"
